title: The Brazen Beauty
overview: Manouchehr, the managing director of a company, and his driver, Latif, rescue Zinat after she attempts to take her own life. Manouchehr asks his friend Iraj to look into Zinat's background. He leaves the company in Iraj's care and sets off on a journey with Zinat. Along the way, they encounter Gohar and Ebraam, two petty criminals who make a living by pickpocketing and blackmailing others...
